cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: For the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've been telling the team 'cleared,' like you. Before I show you my order, what exactly did you clear?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The old stock from the storeroom. What did you order?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, clearing space. Did you authorize fireworks for the launch?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Handheld sparklers. Nothing we'd have to light outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put that wording in the email, then I'll forward the supplier's instructions.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies cleared without its referent; B2 reveals it meant stock removal. A3 masks that gap while demanding permission before exposing the order.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 question is deliberately withheld in A3, which seeks authorization; B4 precise limit becomes A5 demanded written wording.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants to know what was bought and B4 states a limit; A seeks an accountable record, not a general explanation.

heightening.evidence: A5 converts B4 spoken limit into an email before releasing supplier instructions.

specificity.evidence: A1 team and order plus B2 storeroom and A3 launch make the business interaction clear.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 naturally is a brief cover; A5 has a single conditional transaction rather than an explanatory summary.
